title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1985-06-14
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Well-recorded soundboard capture of a lively second set, though track‑listing quirks detract slightly.
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise the clear, sweet audio and describe the show as well‑played with a particularly lively second set. One reviewer gives the performance a 4.5/5 rating, while another notes confusing track labels that make navigation difficult. Overall the music shines, but metadata errors keep it from being flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: One strong positive review (5 stars) highlights excellent sound and performance; a second brief negative note flags track‑listing problems, giving mixed overall feedback from only two reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as well‑recorded and "pretty sweet"; no audio defects mentioned, only metadata/track‑listing errors.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set called lively and well‑played; overall show solid though missing U.S. Blues which some fans missed.
